lines.text: Say good evening, not good night!
Many learners say: Good night, welcome to our shop.
Better: Good evening, welcome to our shop.
Good evening! Welcome to our shop.

data.wrong: Good night, welcome to our shop.
data.right: Good evening, welcome to our shop.

native.tip: Kita bilang “selamat malam” untuk menyapa. Di bahasa Inggris, good night hanya untuk pamit atau tidur. Untuk menyapa pakai good evening.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “Good night, welcome to our shop.” 😅 Untuk menyapa di malam hari, pakai good evening: “Good evening, welcome to our shop.” Dengarkan Kak Carlos, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.

en.tip: We say “selamat malam” to greet. In English, good night is only for saying goodbye or going to bed. To greet, use good evening.
en.caption: Ever say this? “Good night, welcome to our shop.” 😅 To greet at night, use good evening: “Good evening, welcome to our shop.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
